note: Set A contains numerous misbindings of dimensions to the wrong elevation: 9' - 2", 4 1/2", 9' - 11 1/2", 8' - 8", 3' - 6" and 9' - 10 1/4" are attached to South/West/North Bedroom elevations where those values do not appear (e.g. 8' - 8" and 3' - 6" belong to A1 South Bedroom, 9' - 2" and 4 1/2" to C5 North Bedroom), and it invents an 'Artwork … center point X' measurement and an 'above MWD01' condition. Set A does correctly capture the C1 North Living dimensions, the artwork note, TV/MWL01 in C3 West Living and the A1 scale-related facts, but its repeated use of the label 'SOUTH BEDROOM ELEVATION A3 WEST' (A3 is the West Bedroom) corrupts several claims. Set B is mostly value-faithful and gets the A1 scale, MWL01/TV in West Living and the C3 segment dimensions right, but many claims are vague ('interior elevation', 'Wall section', 'room elevation') and it also misassigns 7' - 6" to North Bedroom and 9' - 10" to South Bedroom. Overall B makes far fewer outright misread or invented claims, so it is the better set despite its vagueness.
